decision_scope: Research and proposed direction are ready for an implementation plan. This is not implementation approval, measured user demand, runtime verification, or accessibility certification.
resolved_ambiguities: Ordered Try next queue replaces prior single-slot proposal consistently, with durable order, duplicate policy, explicit remove/clear and Undo.
COMPOSER-DISCOVERY governs final proposed facet priorities; metadata-research is evidence/input, so its secondary Character suggestion is not a conflicting instruction.
Transition table defines mutual movement between Try next and Later, effects of Mark explored and Dismiss, independence from Favorite/reference evidence, and atomic Undo.
Effective-value suppression and source-specific rejection are distinct; logical product/edition versus installation identity and unresolved reconciliation are explicit.
supported_design_boundaries: Named Spitfire/OT/Cinematic Strings audience drives corpus selection; KVR voting and Splice behavior are not inflated into target-audience market share or query frequency.
CS2/CSS and Ark product/edition identities remain distinct; scoped aliases do not merge installations.
Advertised product capability, verified installed patch capability and observed current configuration remain separate. Multi-articulation instruments do not become fictitious files.
User authority wins; raw vendor assertions remain inspectable; unknown is not absence or a negative fact.
Initial baseline, new root, newly found, reconnect, update, uncertain identity and user acquisition date are distinguished. Scope/baseline defects are explicitly prerequisites.
Registry, persistence/default/reset, migration, Undo, automation, clipboard, sync, accessibility, privacy and export policies are addressed at proposal level.
New-to-explore and manual explored state are not usage history, deletion safety, playback, or an automatic external action.

nonblocking_planning_requirements.section: Implementation and validation sequence; acquisitions-design Cross-cutting policy
nonblocking_planning_requirements.requirement: The implementation plan must bind exact registry IDs/schema migration and transaction boundaries, choose measured responsiveness budgets, and list exact verification commands. These are intentionally not certified by this proposal.
nonblocking_planning_requirements.binary_counterexample: After a failed transaction or migration, prior override/suppression/queue order survives reopen; no partial Mark explored transition persists.

nonblocking_planning_requirements.section: Explicit proposed state transitions; newness rules
nonblocking_planning_requirements.requirement: Translate event-versus-product semantics into concrete fixtures, including a new instrument added to a previously explored library and repeated Mark explored/Undo.
nonblocking_planning_requirements.binary_counterexample: A newly discovered patch in an explored library is labeled Updated under the declared review policy, never a fake newly acquired product; dismissing one event does not erase later events.

nonblocking_planning_requirements.section: Metadata assertions and suppression; capability distinction
nonblocking_planning_requirements.requirement: Verify scope across inherited, multi-source and version-specific assertions, not only simple one-tag fixtures.
nonblocking_planning_requirements.binary_counterexample: Removing an effective inherited tag survives rescan; source-only rejection leaves an independent supported assertion; a product webpage cannot make a non-installed articulation appear as an installed patch.

nonblocking_planning_requirements.requirement: Before persistence implementation define date-only manual acquisition semantics and ambiguous physical-to-logical identity reconciliation, with restored-user-state acceptance cases.
nonblocking_planning_requirements.binary_counterexample: Manual acquisition day does not change after timezone change; duplicate editions and offline installations preserve distinct mappings; uncertain anchor replacement retains unresolved queue/edit state rather than silently transferring it.

limits: Reviewed supplied official-source research and inference boundaries; did not independently refetch every linked vendor page.
No usability study, new UI, adapter capability or extraction permission was established.
No product files were edited; no blind criteria read.
